title: Woman Standing Outside House, 1957 B&W Snapshot, Florida
description: Black and white snapshot dated June 1957 depicting a middle-aged woman in a light dress standing on a sidewalk in front of a mid-century home. Palm trees and lush vegetation suggest a tropical or subtropical setting such as Florida. A person sits on the porch steps nearby holding a cup, and the front of a 1940s-50s automobile is visible in the foreground.
